title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Tempered Beveled Glass And Solid Brass Hardware | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds three tiers of organization in a crisp, contemporary design.

  • Triple-tier storage: Helps organize toiletries and display items while freeing up vanity space
  • Tempered glass: 3/8-inch thick glass with beveled edges for safety and strength
  • Solid brass hardware: Built with brass components for enduring support
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a streamlined look
  • Finish flexibility: Offered in multiple designer finish options to coordinate with modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 15 inches H
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 inches (3/8 inch)
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: 16 Inch Triple Tiered Glass Shelf
_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary design 3-tier glass vanity shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelving unit is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass collection of products, this subtle glass shelf unit is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
